title: The Day You Begin
author: Jacqueline Woodson

hero.name: Angelina (girl from cover)
hero.description: Young Black girl with natural hair, wearing a colourful dress, main narrator character from cover illustration by Rafael López
hero.source_note: Named/distinctive illustrated character — source from Creative Fabrica or TPT clip art matching Rafael López illustration style

ambiguous.issue: Could be pictured as a person in an empty room (lonely) or simply one person (singular/only)
ambiguous.reason: In this book 'alone' conveys the feeling of being isolated or left out at school, so the emotional/lonely depiction is correct

ambiguous.issue: Could be pictured as a start button, a starting line, or an abstract arrow — many possible images
ambiguous.reason: The book's title and theme centre on beginning something new; a 'start' or 'begin' action symbol is most appropriate

character_images_needed: Angelina (girl from cover of The Day You Begin)
notes: This book focuses on themes of belonging, identity, and courage when entering a new environment as an outsider. Key vocabulary prioritises social-emotional words (brave, alone, welcome, begin) alongside relationship nouns (friend, family) and the core setting (school). 'Summer' is included because children in the story share — or notably do not share — experiences of summer holidays, making it a key story discussion point. Several words (brave, different, friend, share) already exist in aac_extras and (school) in activity_images, so no new sourcing is needed for those. The hero image will require custom sourcing to match Rafael López's distinctive illustration style, as a generic Boardmaker child icon will not be recognisable to students familiar with the book cover.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap
